'''Lorc''' was a [[Klatooinian]] [[pilot]] who served [[Saw Gerrera]]'s [[Partisans]] during the [[early rebellion against the Galactic Empire]].<ref name="Trivia" /> In the [[Standard year|year]] [[1 BBY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[In the Name of the Rebellion]]" to [[1 BBY]].</ref> Lorc accompanied Gerrera by piloting<ref name="Trivia" /> a [[UT-60D U-wing starfighter/support craft]] during his [[Mission to Jalindi|mission]] to destroy the [[Galactic Empire|Empire's]] communications outpost [[Jalindi Station]], and [[Mission to Faos Station|mission]] to [[Faos Station]] to find out what the Empire is secretly [[transport]]ing.<ref name="In the Name">{{Rebels|In the Name of the Rebellion}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:SawAndEdrio-ITNOTR.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The character Lorc was replaced with Edrio "Two Tubes" to better connect to ''Rogue One''.]]
The character Lorc was intended to appear in "[[In the Name of the Rebellion]],"<ref name="Trivia" /> a two part episode that served as the third and fourth episodes of the animated television series ''[[Star Wars Rebels]]''<nowiki>'</nowiki> [[Star Wars Rebels Season Four|fourth season]],<ref name="In the Name episode">{{SW|url=series/star-wars-rebels/in-the-name-of-the-rebellion-episode-guide|text="In the Name of the Rebellion" Episode Guide | Star Wars Rebels}}</ref> as Saw Gerrera's pilot in an earlier version of the script. To better connect to the [[2016]] film ''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]'', the pilot was changed to [[Edrio]] "Two Tubes",<ref name="Trivia" /> a [[Gender|male]] [[Tognath]] [[mercenary]] pilot<ref name="Edrio DB">{{Databank|edrio-two-tubes|Edrio Two Tubes}}</ref> who first appeared in ''Rogue One'',<ref name="Rogue One">''[[Rogue One: A Star Wars Story]]''</ref> with [[David Acord]] reprising the role as the Tognath.<ref name="Trivia" />
